name: AdvBench
intro: AdvBench 是 Qwen-Omni、LongCat-Omni、ERNIE 5.0 和 OLMo 3 报告中使用的安全评测，用于衡量模型面对有害或对抗提示时的拒答与安全表现。
build_method: 有害行为指令, 对抗后缀搜索
task_type: 安全评测, 对抗提示
eval_feature: 对抗提示, 安全拒答, 攻击迁移
build_method_en: Harmful behavior instructions, adversarial suffix search
eval_feature_en: Adversarial prompts, safety refusal, attack transferability
intro_en: AdvBench is a safety evaluation used by Qwen-Omni, LongCat-Omni, ERNIE 5.0, and OLMo 3 reports to measure refusal and safety behavior under harmful or adversarial prompts.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect harmful behavior instructions"] --> B["Form 500 AdvBench prompts"]
    B["Form 500 AdvBench prompts"] --> C["Generate adversarial suffixes"]
    C["Generate adversarial suffixes"] --> D["Query aligned language models"]
    D["Query aligned language models"] --> E["Detect compliance attempts"]
    E["Detect compliance attempts"] --> F["Judge safety or refusal behavior"]
    F["Judge safety or refusal behavior"] --> G["Compute attack success rate"]
    G["Compute attack success rate"] --> H["Report refusal/safety results"]
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["收集有害行为指令"] --> B["形成500条AdvBench提示"]
    B["形成500条AdvBench提示"] --> C["生成对抗后缀"]
    C["生成对抗后缀"] --> D["查询对齐语言模型"]
    D["查询对齐语言模型"] --> E["检测是否尝试服从"]
    E["检测是否尝试服从"] --> F["判定安全或拒答行为"]
    F["判定安全或拒答行为"] --> G["计算攻击成功率"]
    G["计算攻击成功率"] --> H["报告拒答与安全结果"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2307.15043, the llm-attacks official repository, and the AdvBench dataset card. The benchmark contains 500 harmful behavior instructions and is used with automatically searched transferable adversarial suffixes to test whether aligned models produce objectionable compliance instead of refusing; scoring focuses on attack success, refusal, and safety behavior.
